data.body_text:
Made from Sugarcane and cornstarch
100% compostable garbage bags
Leak proof
Can be used for dry/wet waste & for diaper disposal
Breaks down naturally in the environment
This pack contains 2 rolls, each roll contains 15 bags per roll - small - 19 x 21 inches

We could go on but do you really need more?
